entries.0347f9e6a6470cd9: As insurance underwriting, it handles individual insurance and employee savings insurance, individual annuity insurance and employee savings annuity insurance, and reinsurance. Since its founding, it has provided simple, small-sum products centred on endowment and whole life insurance, mainly to the household market, through post offices throughout the country. For insurance solicitation at post offices, under an insurance counter service agreement with Japan Post Co., Ltd., the solicitation of ordinary whole life insurance, special whole life insurance, ordinary endowment insurance and special endowment insurance, and the acceptance of insurance claim requests, are stipulated. For simple life insurance contracts, under reinsurance contracts with the Postal Savings and Simple Life Insurance Management and Post Office Network Support Organization, it takes over all of that organization's insurance liabilities. At its branches, it also accepts commissioned sales of insurance products from ten companies, including Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. The insurance amount per insured person is subject to a coverage limit under the Postal Privatization Act.
entries.06177d2427fd712a: In May 2026, it published its Medium-Term Management Plan for fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028. It sets its vision for 2040 as 'an essential company that continues to create new value and deliver peace of mind across the country', and positions the plan period as a 'growth and challenge phase'. Its three key strategies are establishing the 'Kampo Value Provision Model' using AI, digital technology and customer data; asset management that captures changes in the investment environment and addresses social issues; and 'Challenge to the Future', strengthening existing partnerships and exploring new fields.
entries.2868fb7e7ae02dad: The main source of revenue is insurance premium and other income received from customers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026 it was ¥2,188,660 million, down from ¥3,154,875 million in the previous year. This is due to factors including lower sales of single-premium whole life insurance. Funds collected are invested mainly in public and corporate bonds from the perspective of ALM, matching yen-denominated assets and yen-denominated liabilities, and investment income generated from these investments is also a source of revenue.

entries.4ce2a7d53b284457: This business underwrites individual insurance, Zaikei insurance, individual annuity insurance, Zaikei annuity insurance, and reinsurance. Under the Postal Privatization Act, simple life insurance contracts transferred from the former public corporation to the Postal Management and Support Organization have been reinsured: the company has entered into reinsurance contracts with that organization and has accepted all of its insurance liabilities. There are limits (enrollment limits) under the Postal Privatization Act and its enforcement order on the insurance amounts the company may underwrite per insured person.
entries.6da82ce0096bcf9f: It states that since its founding it has developed a unique business model of providing simple, small-sum products centred on endowment and whole life insurance, mainly to the household market, through post offices throughout the country, to many customers. While it views these features, such as its products, channels and customer base, as major strengths that other companies do not have, it recognizes the need to transform its business model to adapt to changes in the times and the environment.
entries.748b573626e63f52: It operates a life insurance business under a license and approval obtained under the Insurance Business Act, mainly conducting insurance underwriting and asset management. The group is composed mainly of the company, 1 consolidated subsidiary (Kampo System Solutions Co., Ltd.) and 1 equity-method affiliate, and is a single segment of life insurance business. The consolidated subsidiary Kampo System Solutions Co., Ltd. undertakes the design, development, maintenance and operation of information systems under contract. The company is subject to restrictions under the Japan Post Privatization Act that other life insurance companies are not. As Japan Post Holdings Co., Ltd. notified the Minister for Internal Affairs and Communications on June 9, 2021 that it had disposed of at least 1/2 of the company's shares, the approval procedure for new businesses and the like is no longer required and has moved to a notification system (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.7635977a423b63a2: This business is entrusted by the Postal Management and Support Organization with managing simple life insurance contracts transferred from the former public corporation to that organization under the Postal Privatization Act.
entries.7ac49156caf645c1: This business manages assets through the acquisition of securities, real estate and monetary claims; lending of money (including call loans); lending of securities; deposits or savings; trusts of money, monetary claims, securities or real estate; and derivative transactions and futures foreign exchange transactions, among others. Under the Postal Privatization Act, notification is required when the company intends to manage assets by methods other than the specified ones.
entries.86711a0fbe499e2d: It operates the life insurance business under a license and approval obtained under the Insurance Business Act, mainly carrying out insurance underwriting and asset management.
entries.8873241de69dfbfc: As a life insurance company in the Japan Post Group, it underwrites insurance and manages assets, and provides individual insurance through post offices nationwide.
entries.9157712104831892: This business is entrusted by the Postal Management and Support Organization with managing simple life insurance contracts transferred from the former public corporation to that organization under the Postal Privatization Act. The notes to the business structure diagram state that the company has been entrusted with the collection of insurance premiums, payment of insurance benefits, maintenance and management of contracts, and asset management business, among others, and that part of this work has been re-entrusted.

The counterparties for consignment sales and similar services are 10 companies: Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd., NN Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Life Insurance Company, Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, Tokio Marine & Nichido Anshin Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Nippon Life Insurance Company, Dai-ichi Neo Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company, and MetLife Life Insurance Company.

entries.b449579f0f53b009: Its customers are mainly in the household market. As of March 31, 2026, the number of individual insurance policies in force (including simple life insurance contracts (insurance) it reinsures) was 17,725,000, down 1,084,000 from the end of the previous fiscal year. New individual insurance contracts in the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 428,000, down 46.1% year on year. No external customer accounts for 10% or more of ordinary income. The counterparty to reinsurance of simple life insurance contracts and the client for simple life insurance management services is the Postal Savings and Simple Life Insurance Management and Post Office Network Support Organization.

entries.c6d285b6c2c93fd8: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥168,798 million, up from ¥123,472 million in the previous year. This is due to factors including a decrease in short-term costs associated with acquiring new contracts (the burden of increasing standard policy reserves in the first year) and an increase in spread income from improved investment conditions. Expenses include insurance claims and other payments, investment expenses and operating expenses, and it pays commissions for agency operations to Japan Post Co., Ltd.
